about_the_game:
Experience the adrenaline rush on two wheels!

You’re faced with a decision – and that decision is made at over 250 km/h average speed, in the middle of rush hour traffic.

If you make the wrong choice, your guardian angel will say goodbye.

This game is inspired by the “legendary” Ghost Rider, who has kept entire police forces on their toes on international roads.

Important Note:
As developers and publishers, we strongly advise against mimicking such behavior in real life. Never forget: You only have one life.

Currently included features:

  • Two endless tracks

  • Two selectable characters

  • "Streamer Editor"

  • Customizable track advertisements

  • Customizable motorcycle design

  • Customizable license plate

  • Wheelie & stoppie modes

  • Adjustable cruise control

  • Random weather & manual weather settings

  • Random time of day, including dynamic time changes & manual settings

  • Achievements / Trophies, including trophy room

  • Tutorial pages explaining the streamer mode and controls

At the beginning, you will ride on endless tracks, with time and distance measured – visible at all times in the HUD. During the early access phase, there are plans to add a competitive track where you must race as fast as possible from point A to point B, just like the Ghost Rider. An online leaderboard is also planned.
Note: This track is still under construction (Time Attack “Under Construction”).

Wildly swerving around won’t get you to the finish line. The key is to ride with foresight, steering at the right time.
Controlling a motorcycle at over 250 km/h is an art – it takes a calm hand and nerves of steel.

May you all reach the finish line safely and have an exciting race for the best times!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel I7
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce RTX2060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: OnBoard
  • Additional Notes: Minimum requirements are stated slightly higher than necessary.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 9 7950 or comparable
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce RTX4070
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: OnBoard

short_description: Feel like Ghost Rider and race across the highways and streets of any regions. A race in the grey area of the law, because there is no speed limit for you. But always remember, every decision could be your last. You don't have unlimited guardian angels.
